observation.reproduction: Run ontology-doctor with --project-id and --ontologyc pointing to an executable script whose absolute interpreter does not exist.
observation.actual: The operating system rejects the compiler launch, but compiler.status is available and the recovery hints omit installing a working compiler.
observation.expected: A failed compiler launch is unavailable and includes a useful recovery hint. A launchable compiler without supported version output may have an unknown version.

root_cause: The version probe discarded operating-system launch errors together with unsupported or undecodable version output.

verification.red_before_fix: The regression failed because compiler.status was available.
verification.ruff: passed for the changed implementation and test
verification.limitations: Local execution used a missing interpreter fixture. Hosted checks and merge are separate.

graph.relationship: additional source-bound observation of compiler outcome classification; not a historical cause of the earlier proposal
